newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican family gunned down in turbulent state.
newsitem.headline: Mexican family gunned down in turbulent state.

text.p: Masked gunmen massacred five members of a Mexican family on Wednesday in the politically turbulent western state of Guerrero, officials said on Thursday.
A father and his four children, all peasant farmers, were gunned down by unknown assailants in the remote village of Guayavillal, some 130 miles (240 km) south of Mexico City, police officials said.

Men armed with AK-47 automatic rifles ambushed the family when they arrived at their corn farm on Wednesday, killing Romualdo Hernandez Gomez, 48, and his sons Inocente, 28, Santos, 23, Ruben, 17 and Erick, 14.
Police said they did not know of any motive for the crime nor how many gunmen were involved in the attack. The assailants apparently wore masks to hide their identities.

The village is in the district of Atoyac de Alvarez, where political violence between leftist peasants and ruling party officials has risen in recent years. In 1995, 17 leftist peasants were gunned down by police in that district.
